formula: method points = 1 if any smell is clear
otherwise 0.5 × model probability if borderline (highest among borderline smells); 0 if clean
+ 0.25 for each introduced or worsened smell, capped at 1 per method
score = 100 × (sum of method points) / (number of changed methods); deleted methods are not scored
Low < 25, Medium 25–50, High > 50; small-sample flag if fewer than 3 methods changed
risk.disclaimer: The smell risk score measures code-smell risk in the changed Java methods (Complex Method and Long Parameter List). It is not a probability of bugs, defects or build failure.
